outlet.name: ABC News (US)
outlet.summary: ABC News in the United States, the network's national and world file is leading with Former 'American Idol' contestant sentenced to life without parole for wife's murder; Phone calls, records suggest some Cornell students tried to contain rape allegations; Measles cases surpass 1,000 in Pennsylvania amid state's largest outbreak in decades.

items.headline: Former 'American Idol' contestant sentenced to life without parole for wife's murder
items.detail: Caleb Flynn was found guilty of murdering his wife, Ashley Flynn.

items.headline: Phone calls, records suggest some Cornell students tried to contain rape allegations
items.detail: ABC News has reviewed records from Cornell’s internal investigation — which began in November 2024 and lasted through May 2025.

items.headline: Measles cases surpass 1,000 in Pennsylvania amid state's largest outbreak in decades
items.detail: Measles cases in Pennsylvania have surpassed 1,000 so far this year as the state continues to battle an outbreak of the virus, according to the state health department.

items.headline: WATCH: 'Avengers: Endgame' becomes highest-grossing film ever, again
items.detail: Sophie Flay shares the buzziest stories of the day in "GMA" Pop News.

items.headline: WATCH: People train to run 50K while eating Taco Bell
items.detail: ABC News' Danny New talks to the co-founder of the International Taco Bell 50K, an annual event where people run 31 miles while stopping to eat at 11 Taco Bell restaurants along the way.
